peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 14.5% below its local comparables; 3 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (3.9): 2.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 2 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,308,000 ($2,035 psf, 1,097–1,173 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2023–Aug 2025); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,381 psf (range $2,141–2,991); 14.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $392,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tiong Bahru MRT about 80 m, Havelock MRT about 630 m; closer than 46 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 380 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 110 m), more than 41 of 51 similar developments (the same as 3); nearest hawker centre Beo Crescent Market about 200 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 290 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 760 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 780 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,030 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,050 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,280 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,430 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,600 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,610 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 229 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,418 new sales and 954 resales (2,372 purchases); new sales were 59.8% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 954 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 47 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 954 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,139 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.2%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
